tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru swa ra swa t+yai/ rgyal kun

sh+lo ka 'di gsar bris/ gsang gsum ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mdzes sdug nyams brgya rdzogs pa'i smin legs mar// yongs shar blo gros bye ba'i gter mdzod mchog /rang byung dbyangs kyi rgyal mor gsol ba 'debs// sgra dbyangs lha mo gsung gi dbang phyug mas// dngos su rjes bzung bik+ṣa pa ra ma// bde gshegs srung ba'i dpal dang dza ya ka /'od byed 'byung gnas rnams la= /kha che paṇa chen dā na shī la dang*// sa skya paṇa chen rgyal tsha lung mang po// yon tan khri dang siṃ ha bhā dra'i zhabs// seng ge rgyal mtshan rnams la= /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nam mkha' bsod nams dang*// byams brtse'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal// dwags ston paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs// blo gsal rgya mtsho rnams la= /bod mkhar 'di nas tshig rkang bdun rmor chen gyi gsung*/ chos rje rje btsun mai tri pa// gzhon nu chos dpal dpal 'byor lhun grub rje// chos dbyings rang grol rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang*// blo bzang rgya mtsho rnams la= /mtshungs med chos rje dge ba'i dbang po'i zhabs// ngag dbang sbyin pa blo gros dbang phyug dang*// rje dpon blo gsal 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs rje// kun dga' 'di nas tshig rkang lnga gsar bris lhun grub rnams la= /slob bshad bstan pa'i bdag po gnas gsar pa// ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros zhabs// rje btsun 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// ngag dbang lha mo mchog gi mkhyen brtse yis// bdag blo'i mun nag thams cad rab bcom nas// blo gros snang ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sgra dbyangs lha mo gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa kun dga' legs grub kyi ngor blo gsal dbang pos gnas gsar bo dong e'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// zhes pa 'di la kha skong sogs dgos nges kha shas mchan gsal ltar gu ṇa pas gsar du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// sarba dā maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rje btsun lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs/ bla ma dang rje btsun dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo dbyangs can bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rjes gnang nod par bya ste/ gnas yid dang mthun par ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhungs bas legs par byug maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa byas rang nyid lus dri bzang gis byug rin po che'am rdza'i bum par bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas chu blangs la blug rin chen lnga/ 'bru lnga/ bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long gi nang du legs par sbyar la bum par blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha gcod par bya'o// de nas thog mar skyabs 'gro lan gsum byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bya/ de'i ched du lha mo dbyangs can bsgom snyam du sems bskyed/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa rgya chen po dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pas mchod/ yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de'i rjes la/ swa bhā wa brjod de/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du rang sems hrīṃ dmar po zhig tu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa gsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi me long zhig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog bye ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon pas ye shes kyi me long bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/

rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ ska rags do shal la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam/ zhi ba dang*/ 'dzum pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar bsgoms pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba spyan drangs la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ de'i rjes la mdun gyi bum pa'i nang du'ang*/ lha mo bdag bskyed bzhin du bskyed nas/ ye shes spyan drangs pa sngar bzhin bya/ de nas mdun gyi lha mo la mchod pa bsham pa'am/ med na yid kyis bsams la ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ rang dang mdun gyi lha mo gnyis ka'i snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīṃ dmar po/ de'i mthar/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba/ de klog pa'i tshul du sngags bzla zhing*/ de'i tshe yig 'bru de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sangs kyis dag cing*/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgya chen po rgyas par bsam zhing bsnyen pa 'di 'bum bya/ de nas thun 'jog khar lha mo bum pa la bstim/ thun mtshams su lha mo'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal paṇ+ḍi ta/

gzhan yang yul phyogs kyi shes rab che zer ba dang*/ chos mkhas zer ba thams cad kyi shes rab thams cad hrīṃḥyig gi rnam par bsdus/ rang gi snying gar thim pas lus thams cad 'od kyis gang bar bsam zhing shes rab phun sum tshogs pa de dag dang ldan par bsam mo// yang dang yang du bya'o// mtshams zhag bdun po de las mi dgos so// 'di ni gzhan dang khyad par yod pa'o// gzhan dang 'dra na khyad par chung*// kun la yod na khyad chos min// mang na gser yang brin rgyu med// lkugs pa la bstan na smra shes par 'gyur ro// zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgoms na rtsom blo/ go blo/ bshad blo/ blo gros thams cad la thogs pa med do// blo 'phel 'di las zab pa rgya bod gnyis la med/ yod re kan no// slob dpon phya pa la gtsang nag pas zhus pas/ nga la nor 'di las med gsungs nas rtsig par byung bas/ gtsang nag pas grwa bskor la phyin pa'i rnyed pa gser zho bdun/ dar kha bco lnga yod pa phul nas zhus pas/ rtsig ge pa zhig la gnang byung bar bsgrubs pas blo mchog tu gyur par nges so// bu'i dam pa snying 'dra ba la bstan par bya zhing mang na rang nyid la gnod/ 'di'i khungs chod pa byung na'ang rang la phan e thogs blta'o gsungs/ de las gzhan na lha mos chad pa chod cig gsungs/ byin nas mnal dam du dgag par bya'o// 'di las zab pa yod re kan gsungs par gda'o// bsnyen pa song na bum pa'i chus khrus bya'o// grib la gzab pa gal che/ bsnyen pa'i dus nag mo dang mi 'grogs/ gtsang sbra gal che// / ༈ /thun mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma mar la sogs pa dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa cig bsham/ bsang sbyang 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'o ma lta bus gang bar bsam/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥb ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā zhes lan gsum brjod pas mdun gyi lha mo'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bas mnyes par bsam/

sngar bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes bya la thog pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgya chen po rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ mthar bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum chu dmar khrug ger song bar bsams la khrus bya/ gzhan rnams gsung bzhin bya'o// paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung gis dbyangs can ma'i gsang sgrub 'di gshin rje gshed kyi man ngag rgyud 'thus bod du ma 'gyur ba'i gzhung du gtogs pa yin no gsungs so// dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen pa cung zad song nas 'di sgrub na bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs so// gang gis srid pa'i 'ching ba kun// lha mo khyod dran gus bzlas pas// skad cig nyid la 'joms mdzad pa'i// rgyal ba kun gyi yum la 'dud// ma rig ma rig las byung ba// ye shes ye shes mchog mnga' bas// myur ba myur bar gcod mdzad pa'i// lha mo'i lha mo khyod la 'dud// blo gros mchog kun stsol mdzad cing*// blo gros mtha' yas ster mdzad pa// blo gros shes rab pha rol phyin// blo gros mi zad gter gyur 'dud// ces pa'i rje btsun ma'i bstod pa 'di lo paṇa gang rung gis mdzad par nges so// ༈ /rten gyi gang zag shes bya la blo gzhol bar 'dod pas/ rje btsun ma sgrub pa la thog mar bla ma la rjes gnang nod par bya dgos pas de'i tshul ni/ de'ang dus bzang po la gnas khang byi dor sogs sgrub pa'i dus ltar byas la/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad re khā dkar pos bris/ tshon dmar pos byug pa'i dbus su bum pa bcud kyis gang ba sgrub thabs kyi skabs ltar bsham/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ bum par sngar bzhin lha mo bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab pas lha mo'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byung bas bum pa gang bar bsam/

de nas slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag 'tshal yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ sems bskyed cho ga rgyas bsdus blang*/ bshags pa bya/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin dngos// slob dpon gyis ni lha mo yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa'i byin rlabs ni/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs dmar ser skyil krung can g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon glegs bam dang ut+pal can du bskyed/ de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byon lha mo'i rnam par thim pas/ lha mo'i rnam par gyur par mos la/ mngon rtogs ltar ngo sprod la bsgom du gzhug yang slob dpon dang bum pa'i lha las lha mo bstims shing bum chus dbang bskur la spyi bo dang*/ lus la 'thor khar 'thung zhing khrus byed du gzhug go /ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung bzlas pa'i byin rlabs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad lha mo'i sngags kyi rnam par byung*/ slob ma'i lus dang khyad par mgrin par thim par gyur/ slar yang slob dpon dang bum pa'i lha yi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying gar zla ba la hrīṃḥganas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ hrīṃḥgi mthar sngags phreng rnams 'khod pa la sngags phyi ma rnams rim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ swa ra zhes pa'i sngags rjes zlos bdun nam nyer gcig gi bar bya/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum zhu/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la zhes sogs bya/ me tog spyi bor bzhag

sngar bzhin bum dbang bskur/ bum chus khrus bya'o// gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes gnang ni/ slob ma lha mo'i skur gnas pa de stod smad nas rim gyis phyag g.yon pa'i me long la bsdu/ yang me long la lha'i sku gsal bar bsgom/ de yang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa spros bral ngang du lhan ner bzhag go /rjes yon ci 'byor dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' ston sogs la longs spyod/ mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs mjug chog spyi dang mthun/ slob ma la sgrub thabs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa sbyin/ shin tu zab pa'i gsang sgrub yin pas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma ma gtogs gzhan la sbyin par mi bya'o// 'di bris dge ba gang yod des// 'gro ba rnams kyi blo mun rnams// bsal nas lha mo dbyangs can ma'i// go 'phang nyid la 'god par shog /oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ sngags kyi dag yig go /hrīṃ sa bon gyi dag yig go/ ༈ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi nyams len bya tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ yid 'ong ngag gi bdud rtsi 'joms ba'i dpal// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan rje btsun ma// blo gros mig gi gter gyur lhag pa'i lha// dbyangs can lha mo snying dbus pad+mor byon// de la 'dir shin tu zab pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du song nas/ bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rnam gsum la// lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig gus pa yis// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir shes rab phun sum tshogs par bya/ de'i ched du lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig nas/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig gi bar lan gcig oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems yi ge hrīṃḥdamar po cig tu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi me long gcig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog bye ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon pas ye shes kyi me long bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ ska rags do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can zhi ba dang 'dzum pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga rang gi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīṃḥdamar po'i mthar/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswa hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thogs ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sangs kyis dag cing*/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgya chen po rgyas par gyur/ ces brjod cing sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis brgya stong la sogs pa bzla/ mthar thun 'jog khar rang lha mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu phyogs thams cad du bun gyis 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ paṇ+ḍi ta/ gzhan yang yul phyogs kyi shes rab che ba dang*/ chos mkhas par byed pa thams cad kyi shes rab thams cad hrīṃḥyig gi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi snying gar thim pas khong pa thams cad 'od kyis gang bas shes rab phun sum tshogs par bsam pa yang yang bya'o// rgyun gyi nyams len la 'di'i 'jug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sgra dbyangs lha mo 'grub gyur nas zhes pa nas/ 'god par shog ces sogs kyis dge ba bsngo bar bya'o// 'di'i bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma bya bar 'dod pas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhungs bas legs par byug maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i steng du rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po'i steng du rin po che'am/ rdza'i bum pa'i nang du bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas chu gtsang ma blangs pa'i nang du rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/

bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long du sbyar la blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha bcad gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba mar gyi rgyan ci mdzes kyis spras pa la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod lnga bsham/ rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra bya/ lus dri bzang gis byug gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ stan nang tshang can gyi mdun du dril bu me tog gi snod sogs sta gon bya/ yar ngo'i tshes grangs bzang ba'i phyi dro nas sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs la bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ thog mar mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs nas ā khaṃ swā hā zhes byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung rang la gnyis su med par thim gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ de nas bum pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīṃḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi me long cig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las lha mo dbyangs can ma zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar brjod/

mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai ar+ghaṃ aḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gis srid pa'i 'ching ba kun// lha mo khyod dran gus bzlas pas// skad cig nyid la 'joms mdzad pa'i// rgyal ba kun gyi yum la 'dud// ma rig ma rig las byung ba// ye shes ye shes mchog mnga' bas// myur bar myur bar gcod mdzad pa'i// lha mo'i lha mo khyod la 'dud// blo gros mchog tu stsol mdzad pa'i// blo gros mtha' yas ster mdzad pa// blo gros shes rab pha rol phyin// blo gros mi zad gter gyur 'dud// ces bstod/ rang dang bum pa'i nang gi lha mo gnyis ka'i snying gi nang du zhes pa nas/ blo gros rgyas par gyur par bdag bskyed ltar bsam zhing brjod pa sngags thun re la ji tsam 'gro bar bzla/ thun mjug tu bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa'i spro bsdu dmigs pa yang yang bya'o// gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'o ma lta bus gang bar bsams la/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥb liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul bas/ lha mo'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ gong ltar mchod pa bya/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de lta bu zhag bdun gyi bar thun bzhir bcad de nyams su blang*/ zhag bdun gyi thun tha ma la bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum chu dmar khrug ger song bar bsams la khrus bya/ 'di bsnyen sgrub sbags par zhag bdun po des chog cing*/ rgyun du bdag bskyed kho na ma chags pas don 'grub bo// gzhan phan yon sogs yig rnying las shes par bya'o// blo gros thogs med stsol ba'i lha// blo 'phel dmar mo sgrub pa'i thabs// blo ldan dam pa'i gsung gi ngor// blo gsal srol 'dzin des smras so// zhes sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub nyams su len tshul gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa 'di'ang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi gsang ba sngags kyi rab 'byams pa pad+ma chos 'phel gyis bka' gnang ltar ris med pa'i grub pa'i mtha' la blo gros kyi sbyang ba dkar ba'i bya bral lhun grub kyis ra sa 'khrul snang gi gan+dho la dang 'dab 'byor ba'i gnas su sug bris su btab pa dge zhing bkra shis/

maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ blo gros spobs pa ma lus pa// stsol mdzad yi dam lha mo la// btud nas de yi rjes gnang ba// dam pa'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya// 'dir shin tu zab pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba gnas khang yid du 'ong bar stegs bu'i khar maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du rin po che'i bum par bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas blangs pa'i chus gang ba'i nang du rin po che lnga/ bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long gi nang du sbyar ba blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha bcad/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ g.yas g.yon gang bder gtor ma zlum po theb kyus bskor ba mngar gsum dang dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs sta go bya/ stan bde ba la 'dug mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ lha mo'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas slob ma bos la me tog bkye bsdu dang khrus sogs bya/ slob dpon gyis snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal zhes sogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/

de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bla med kyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin zhing*/ de la rgyud sde mang du yod pa dang*/ 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud 'bum pa nas bshad pa'i shes rab skyed pa'i lha shin tu zab pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub tu grags pa sgra dbyangs lha mos rjes su bzung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bik+ṣa pa ra ma nas brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa la slob dpon la sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin dngos// slob dpon khyod kyis lha mo yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzad par zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzad par zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sngon 'gro rim pa rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsum yod pas/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam du mos gus mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i rnam smin ma dag pa'i phung khams thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo dhīḥyig dmar ser 'od zer 'phro ba zhig tu gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon ut+pal bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon dang bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i rnam pas nam mkha' gang bar thib thib byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs su gsal ba de nyid skad cig gis sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i skur gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba zhag gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon pas ye shes kyi me long bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan cing*/

dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa dang*/ 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgoms pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīṃḥyig dmar po dang bcas pa gsal lam ste yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi bum pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma dpag tu med pa char babs pa ltar byon pas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod la dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ ā be sha ya dzaḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ bum pa mgor bzhag ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes brjod cing bum chu blud/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa lha mo'i sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang khyad par mgrin pa'i gnas su thim/ slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las kyang sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥyig gi mthar dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pa man chad kyis brtan par byas par mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan nyer gcig gi bar du mdzad par zhu/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā nyer gcig de ltar bzlas lung thob pa'i bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/

bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags nus ldan du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum/ de brtan pa'i phyir du bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sngar ltar chu dbang bskur/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams lha mo dbyangs can mar gsal ba de nyid stod smad nas 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas mthar phyag g.yon gyi me long la bsdus te gsal ba dwangs pa mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ slar yang de'i ngang las lha mo'i skur lam gyis gyur pa de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa mi long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal zhing dwangs la mi rtog pa'i ngang la lhod kyis klod nas ci nus su mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de brtan byed bum pa'i chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub pas/ 'di'i sgom thabs kyi lung bklag gnas skabs de dag tu khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du 'dzin par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum du mdzad par zhu/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal sogs/ deng nas sogs/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma sā la'i pho nyar grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ rjes mchod pa rnams kha gso/ byin rlabs mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab pa spyi dang mthun par bya'o// de ltar sā la'i pho nya dbyangs can ma'i// rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me 'di// gong ma'i gsung dang bla ma'i man ngag ltar// gsal bar bkod 'dis 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog

/ces sā la'i pho nya dbyangs can ma gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di'ang rnam par rgyas pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi gsang sngags kyi rab 'byams pa pad+ma chos 'phel gyis snga mo nas bskul zhing*/ nye char dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtsho lags kyis skul ma gnang ba'i zhal ngo ma mchog par ris su ma chad pa'i grub mtha' la blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba bya bral rgan po lhun grub kyis rang gnas rmor dgon par sug bris su btab pa maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// ༈ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub bya tshul blo gros nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo swa ra swa t+yai/ skal bzang ut+pal rgyas pa'i mtsho gling du// dri med thugs rje'i ngang mo rol pa'i mod// legs bshad mgrin pa'i rdza rnga bzhad pa'i sgras// thub bstan kun dgar 'gyid pa de la 'dud// gang zhig zab cing rgya che'i gting*// shin tu rtogs dka'i rigs gnas mtsho// rgal 'dod skal bzang don mthun rnams// sgrub thabs gru chen 'di longs shig /de la 'dir gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar po gsang sgrub bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par nos te/ stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'khod nas khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i don du/ dri ma med pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bya/ de'i phyir du lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs lan gcig gis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīṃḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi me long gcig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog bye ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon pas ye shes kyi me long bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ zhi ba dang*/ 'dzum pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīṃ yig dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs kyis dag shes bya thams cad la blo gros rgyas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul du brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bzla'o// thun 'jog khar/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ paṇ+ḍi ta/ gzhan yang yul phyogs thams cad kyi shes rab che ba dang*/ chos la mkhas zer ba thams cad kyi shes rab hrīṃḥyig gi rnam par bsdus nas/ rang gi snying gar thim pas khong pa thams cad 'od kyis gang zhing shes rab phun sum tshogs par bsam pa yang yang bya'o// bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig mtshams zhag bdun las lhag mi dgos/ yid ches kyi dad pa dang brtson pa rnam par dag pas zhag bdun du bsgrubs na/ rtsom blo/ go blo/ bshad blo/ rtsod blo sogs blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes yig rnying las 'byung ngo*// mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /sgra dbyangs lha mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// khyed kyi sa la 'god par shog /rin po che'am rdza'i bum par bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas blangs pa'i chu gtsang ma'i nang du rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long gi nang du sbyar la blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha bcad/ mchod gtor sogs bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ dri bzang gi chus dag par byas la gza' skar tshes grangs bzang por stan bde bar 'khod la mchod pa rnams/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā washud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste rang dang gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ de nas bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hrīṃḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi me long cig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las lha mo dbyangs can ma zhes pa nas gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gis srid pa'i 'ching ba kun// lha mo khyod dran gus bzlas pas// skad cig nyid la 'joms mdzad pa'i// rgyal ba kun gyi yum la 'dud// ma rig ma rig las byung ba// ye shes ye shes mchog mnga' bas// myur ba myur bar gcod mdzad pa'i// lha mo'i lha mo khyod la 'dud// blo gros mchog kun stsol mdzad cing*// blo gros mtha' yas ster mdzad pa'i// blo gros shes rab pha rol phyin// blo gros mi zad gter gyur 'dud// zhes bstod/ de nas rang dang bum pa'i nang gi lha mo gnyis ka'i snying gi nang du zhes pa nas/

blo gros chen po rgyas par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ thun re la'ang sngags ji tsam 'gro bar bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ de nas/ zla shar mkha' la rgyu skar tshogs bzhin du// bka' dang bstan bcos kun gyi tshig dang don// ma lus bdag gi yid la rab bkra ba'i// gzungs kyi dngos grub stsol cig dbyangs can ma// dbyangs can sngon gyi thugs dam ltar byon te// bdag gi lus ngag yid la myur zhugs la// lce la rgyal ba'i spobs pa yid la ni/ chos kun so sor rtog pa'i kun mkhyen stsol// snga phyi 'brel chags mi zlos dngos shugs gsal// mi 'gal ngo bo dbye sogs gnad don tshang*// ma tshang skong sogs tshig don kun 'byed pa'i// 'chad la kun gzigs ltar mdzod dbyangs can ma// tshig la sgra dang don la gtan tshigs kyis// phas rgol 'khrul pa bzlog phyir phra zhib kyi// rnam dpyod 'gyed la srid zhir zla med pa// rtsod la 'jam dbyangs dngos mdzod dbyangs can ma// snyan 'jebs tshig don nyams rdzogs sdeb sbyor mkhas// bcad lhug spel dang zab gsal zur phyin cing*// ro 'dzin dbyangs can bye bas mngon rol pa'i// rtsom pa'i ngo mtshar sgo phyes dbyangs can ma// de ltar dad gdung drag pos mngon bstod pas// tshe rabs kun tu snying gi pad+mo ru// lhan skyes bzhin du dbyangs can nyer bzhugs te// rmongs bral mkhas pa'i yang rtse thob par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje smon lam dang*// dbyangs can lha mo'i sgyu 'phrul bden tshig mthus// bdag gis bsgom bzlas dad pas dus kun tu// dbyangs can lha mos mngon sum rjes 'dzin shog

/ces pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ sgrub pa'i mthar bum pa'i ye shes pa badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu dmar khrug ger song bar bsams la khrus byas pas dri ma dag par byed do// dbyangs can ma dkar mo la bsnyen pa song nas 'di nyid sgrub na bar chad chung bar bshad la/ rnal 'byor bla med nas bshad pa'i lha yin kyang kun spyod rgyud sde 'og ma ltar sha chang sgog btsong grib kyi rigs la 'dzem zhing gtsang sbra gang che byed pa dang*/ bsnyen pa'i dus su bud med mi bsten pa sogs dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su blangs na shin tu myur bar bshad pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis gus pas bsnyen par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ gang zhig snying gi me long gsal ba'i ngogs// mtha' dag shes bya'i snang brnyan lta 'dod rnams// sgra dbyangs lha mo 'di nyid sten cig ces// rdo rje 'chang gis dri med rgyud sder gsungs// de slad dad dang brtson pas nyer drangs te// 'khrul bral rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin// rmad byung lha mo bsnyen pa'i thabs tshul la// zhugs pa'i skye bo 'di dag skal ba bzang*// 'dir 'bad dge ba nyin mor byed pa'i khams// rnam mang blo gsal gleng bzhi'i mkhar 'phags nas// legs bshad 'od stong bzhad pa'i 'dzum phreng gis// thub bstan pad+mo rtag tu 'byed gyur cig /ces sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub bya tshul blo gros nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad ldan dge slong bsam gtan rgya mtshos shel gyi phreng ba dang bcas gsol ba btab pa dang*/ slad nas mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dam pa tho'u kwan sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung gis yang yang bskul ngor zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sbyar ba'o//

༈ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang byed tshul yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang zhig dran pa'i mod la nang gi mun// sel byed ye shes 'od zer stong 'bar bas// skal bzang snying gi chu skyes rgyas mdzad pa// rgyal yum shes rab lha mor gus phyag 'tshal// de la dbyangs ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ byi dor legs par bgyis pa'i gnas khang yid du 'ong bar maṇ+ḍal gyi khar rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas blangs pa'i chus gang ba'i nang du/ rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long gi nang du legs par sbyar la bum par blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha bcad/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ 'bul gtor zlum po dkar po theb kyus bskor ba/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ rdor dril/ me tog sogs sta gon byas te/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams sgrub thabs kyi nang bzhin btang nas/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ lha mos sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la bzlas pa ci 'grub tu bya/ de nas slob ma rnams la khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu byas te/ slob dpon gyis byams dang snying rje'i sems sngon du 'gro bas kun slong gsal 'debs tshul rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te byas la/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ ji skad du/ shes rab brgya pa las/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan ni// kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin// de ltar gnyis ka sgrub pa'i phyir// dang po 'bad de shes rab skyed// ces gsungs pa ltar/

chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba yin cing*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la'ang ji lta ji snyed rtogs pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa gal shin tu che bas grol ba don du gnyer ba rnams kyis de lta bu'i shes rab khyad par can skyed pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos shing*/ shes rab gong 'phel du byed pa'i thabs kyang mang du yod na'ang mchog tu gyur pa ni sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma la rten nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs kyi shes rab sgrub pa 'di yin la/ de'i gnad kyis rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du mas 'di nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung zhing thugs dam du mdzad pa'i mthu las shes par bya ba'i gnas mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi mthu dri ma med pa brnyes te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa sha stag byung zhing*/ khyad par du dbyangs can ma dmar po gsang sgrub tu grags pa 'di ni kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bik+ṣa pa ra ma nas nye bar brgyud de bod gangs can gyi rtog ge pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu phya pa chos kyi seng ges 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs dang man ngag gi skor rnams legs par gsan zhing de la rang gi slob ma mkhas pa seng chen brgyad du grags pa'i nang tshan gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges zhus pas/ nga la nor 'di las lhag pa med gsungs nas ma gnang*/ slar gtsang nag pa grwa skor la byon nas gser zho bdun dang dar kha bco lnga yod pa phun nas nan tan du gsol ba btab pas tseg ge pa zhig la gnang nas khong gis bsgrubs pas blo mchog tu gyur te sus kyang bsgrun du med pas mkhas par gyur pa yin la/ gsung rgyun las kyang 'di nyid zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgoms na/ rtsom blo/ go blo/ bshad blo/ rtsod blo sogs blo gros thams cad la thogs pa mi mnga'o zhes phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub kyi gter du gyur pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba 'bul ba la slob dpon gyis bya ba'i rim pa thams cad grub nas/

slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ yon dbul ba dang*/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa yid la bya ba sogs yod pas/ slob dpon sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mar 'du shes bskyed de rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod la yon dbul du gzhug snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin dngos// slob dpon khyod kyis lha mo yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*// byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs par mos te/ de'i spyan sngar tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa mdzad par zhu/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na zhes pa nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o'i bar lan gsum dpon slob mnyam du brjod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs la/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du de'i bslab bya rnams tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas byang sdom 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum brjod/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol lan gsum/ de dag gis sngon 'gro'i rim pa grub nas dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsum yod pas/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i rnam smin gyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ pad zla'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo dhīḥdamar ser yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon ut+pal gyi steng du glegs bam bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon dang bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar mo zhag gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon ye shes kyi me long bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la hrīṃḥyig dmar po dang bcas pas mtshan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig tu bdag mdun gnyis las kyang rang 'dra dpag tu med pa byung nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la dril bu gsil/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai ā be sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod bum pa mgor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥ.a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing bum chu blud/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba song*/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa lha mo'i sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang*/ khyad par mgrin pa'i gnas su thim/ slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs snying gar zla ba la hrīṃ yig gi mthar dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pa man chad kyis brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan nyer gcig gi bar du mdzod/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes nyer gcig rjes zlos byed du gzhug de nas slob dpon la me tog gtor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags nus ldan du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// ces brjod cing me tog spyi bor 'thor/ sngar ltar chu dbang bskur/ des gsung gi rjes gnang song ngo*// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams lha mor gsal ba stod smad rim gyis 'od du zhu nas mthar phyag g.yon pa'i me long la thim/ des mtshon te chos thams cad rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ slar yang de'i ngang las lha mo'i skur lam gyis gyur pa de yang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ 'di la chu dbang bskur ba yig rnying du mi gsal yang phyag len mdzad pas sngar bzhin du chu dbang bya/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub/ sgrub thabs kyi lung yang bar 'dir bklag de'i gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs lan gsum/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i bka' drin btang rag gi yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu byas nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar na byin rlabs dang dngos grub kyi gter du gyur pa lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub ces zab pa las kyang ches zab pa de nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba phul grub pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba la mchod pa rnams kha gso/ byin rlabs byas te mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o// smras pa/ 'phags bod mkhas grub klu dbang stong phrag rtse ba'i gnas// zab cing rgya che lha mo'i phrin las chu gter la// 'jug 'dod skal bzang don mthun gang dag byin rlabs kyi// gru chen 'dir zhugs dngos grub nor bu'i cod can longs// zhes lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bya tshul yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba 'di ni/

yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i gsung gi me tog spyi bor lhungs pa la brten nas mang du thos pa'i dge slong zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa blo gros mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī swa ra swa t+yai/ sgra dbyangs lha mo gsung gi dbang phyug mas// mngon sum rjes bzung bik+ṣa pa ra ma// bde gshegs srung ba'i dpal dang dza ya ka /'od byed 'byung gnas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kha che paṇa chen dā na shī la dang*// sa skya paṇa chen rgyal tsha lung mang po// yon tan khri dang siṃ ha bha dra'i zhabs// seng ge rgyal mtshan rnams la= /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bla ma bsod nams dang*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan karma 'phrin las pa// tshar chen rje dang byams pa don grub zhabs// gzhon nu chos dpal rnams la= /dpal 'byor lhun grub zur chen thams cad mkhyen// blo bzang rgya mtsho dge ba'i dbang po'i zhabs// ngag dbang sbyin pa blo gros dbang phyug dang*// blo gsal phun tshogs rnams la= /rmor chen rje dang khyab bdag gnas gsar pa// kun dga' blo gros bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// bstan pa'i sgron me phrin las yon tan zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma

byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ rnams la= /zhes sam/ yang na/ dpal 'byor lhun grub zur chen thams cad mkhyen// zhes pa yan sngar ltar la/ de nas/ blo bzang rgya mtsho thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags// bde ba'i rdo rje bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*// 'jigs med dbang po rnams la= /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bstan pa'i sgron me dang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag bstan pa rab rgyas sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes sbyar/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// srid dang nges 'byung chu yis rab brlan pa'i// byang chub sems gnyis ut+pal 'dzum pa'i rtser// yang dag lta ba'i 'bras bus phyug par shog /khyad par khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i lha mo yis// mngon sum nyid du rjes su bzung ba'i mthus// so sor rtog pa'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig /de mthus zab dang rgya che'i gzhung lugs la// ji bzhin dpyod pa'i blo gros rab gsal zhing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol legs son nas// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus pa blo gros ut+pal rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī māṃ gu ru swa ra swa t+yai/ de la 'dir shin tu zab pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub la brten nas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas par 'dod pas/ rjes su gnang ba legs par mnos te/ stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'khod nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// yid can srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir// rdo rje sgra dbyangs lha mo bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/

phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pam̐ yig las 'khrungs pad dkar 'dab brgyad dang*// a las dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// rang sems ngo bo hrīṃḥyig dmar po las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// tshur 'dus ye shes me long gcig tu gyur// de nyid yongs gyur sgra dbyangs lha mo ni// sku mdog bye ru'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la// nyi gzhon stong gis 'khyud pa'i gzi byin 'bar// rab mdzes zhi 'dzum brgyad gnyis lang tshos sgeg /phyag g.yas 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu dang*// g.yon pas dwangs gsal ye shes me long bsnams// zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pad zlar rol// yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// snang stong zung 'jug chu zla'i gzugs brnyan ltar// gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum dang*// thugs dbus hrīṃḥlas byung ba'i 'dzum zer gyis// lho phyogs rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i dga' tshal nas// ye shes spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim// oṃ shrī swa ra swa t+yai badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thugs kar zla steng hrīṃ yig dmar po'i mthar// sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis// sdig sgrib kun sbyangs shes bya thams cad la// thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgyas par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la// oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswā hā/

zhes sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul du ci nus su bzla/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni bdun phrag gcig tu bzlas na blo gros kyi mthu chen po thob par bshad do// thun mthar/ thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// mkhas rnams mkhyen rab hrīṃḥyig rnam par bsdus// snying gar thim pas 'od kyis lus kun khyab// blo gros pad+mo mchog tu rgyas gyur cig /ces brjod cing yang yang bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// sgra dbyangs lha mo gsung gi dbang phyug mas// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// yang 'di'i bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma bya bar 'dod na gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhungs pas byugs/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i ngos su rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po can bris pa'i steng du rin po che'am/ rdza'i bum par bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas blangs pa'i chu gtsang mar rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ bzang po drug sin+dhū ra rnams me long gi nang du sbyar ba blugs/ dar le brgan kha gang gis kha bcad/ mchod gtor sogs mdzes par bshams la/ thog mar mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin chen snod// yangs shing rgya cher oṃ yig zhu ba las// byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub mchod pa'i sprin// dwangs shing thogs med nam mkha'i khams gang gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis brlab/ de nas skyabs sems nas bzung*/ ye shes pa rang la bstims pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar sngon du song nas/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig las byung ba'i// rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus// pam̐ las pad dkar a las zla ba'i steng*// thugs srog ngo bo hrīṃ yig dmar po las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// zhes pa nas/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// oṃ swa ra swa t+yai ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ mtha' klas sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// ye shes phung po gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzugs// dran pa tsam gyis blo gros mchog stsol ba'i// rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bdag mdun thugs kar zla steng hrīṃḥdamar mthar// zhes sogs bzlas dmigs gsal btab la bzlas pa ci nus su bya/ thun mthar bdag mdun gnyis ka la dmigs nas/ thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// zhes sogs brjod cing bsam/ thun mtshams su/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig las// byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs su// 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥ.i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin gyi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag sogs sems can kun// ma rig mun pa'i 'ching ba rab bsal nas// shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa yi// blo gros snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas 'dod don gsol/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag bdun gyi bar du thun bzhir ma chag par nyams su blangs mthar/ badz+ra muḥs bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum chur dmar ltem gyis song bar bsams la khrus bya/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub sbags par zhag bdun po des chog cing*/ rgyun du bdag bskyed kho na ma chags pas don 'grub bo// zhes pa'ang rang slob mañju'i ming can gyi skyes thob kyi lang tsho sgeg pa'i cha rkyen du shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu/ dge'o// ༈ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo la gsol ba 'debs pa blo gros mchog sbyin zhes bya ba/ na maḥshrī māṃ gu ru swa ra swa t+yai/ phul byung legs byas bye ba'i tshon ris kyis// tshogs gsum lang tsho'i mtshar sdug yongs gang ba// bcom ldan 'das ma swa ra swa tī yis// bdag gi yid la blo yi mchog sbyin mdzod// rnam pa kun ldan 'chi med lam yangs por// zung 'jug brgya byin mdzub rjes bris pa yi// mtshan bzang bye ru'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i gzugs// bdag gi mig la mngon sum bstan du gsol// rtag tu brjod pa'i pha rol las brgal kyang*// rig sngags nor bu'i rgyud mang rdung ba'i sgras// 'gro mang ma rig gnyid las slong ba'i dbyangs// bdag gi ngag la mngon sum zhugs par mdzod// spros bral 'chi med lam gyi pha mtha' yis// mtshon min mkhyen brtse'i nyams brgyas rol pa mo// don dam rdo rje sgra dbyangs lha mo'i zhal// bdag gi snying la mngon sum shar bar mdzod// de ltar tha mal 'khrul ba'i sgo gsum po// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer byin brlabs pas// rig byed 'dzin dbang bye ba'i gtsug tor rtser// rkang sen ut+pal dal gyis 'god mkhas shog /ces pa'ang bsil ldan ljongs kyi snyan ngag smra ba sgra dbyangs lha mo dgyes pa'i 'bangs kyis gang shar yud tsam la brjod pa de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //shubhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
